# Giggster

> > Giggster is a marketplace for booking unique filming locations and event venues, with a creator rewards program for content sharing.

Giggster connects filmmakers, photographers, and event planners with distinctive locations for productions and gatherings. The platform includes the Giggster Creator Club, which rewards users for sharing content on social media platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.

## Key Topics

- Giggster Creator Club
- Filming locations
- Event venues
- Content creator rewards
- Social media challenges
- Instagram
- TikTok
- Facebook
- Influencer community
- Earn credits
- Location booking
- Content sharing
- User authentication

## Creator Program

- [Giggster Creator Club](https://creators.giggster.com/): Creator rewards program for sharing Giggster content on social media

## Account & Authentication

- [Notifications & Account Verification](https://landing.giggster.com/notifications): User notifications and account verification page with social login options
